data: Which of the following sub-networks are represented in the figure for p=0.5?

The question asks which sub-networks are represented in the figure for p=0.5. From the caption, we know that the sub-networks represented are SA (self-attention), FF (feed-forward), and CA (cross-attention). The figure shows two graphs: one for encoder layer usage at p={0.2, 0.5} and another for decoder layer usage at p={0.2}. In both graphs, there are lines representing SA_p0.5 and FF_p0.5. Therefore, the sub-networks represented in the figure for p=0.5 are SA and FF.
